keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «스마트폰은 우리가 사는 방식을 바꿔 놓았다(주제)» 와 «스마트폰은 강력한 도구지만, 휘둘리지 말고 우리가 다스려야 한다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (smartphones changed the way we live) and the conclusion (a smartphone is a powerful tool, but we should control it instead of letting it control us). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.qen: What can we do with smartphones?
boxes.a: Video call, pay for things, and find our way
Control our phones, not let them control us

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: In 2007, a small device with a touch
was shown on a stage. Smartphones soon spread around the world and changed the way we
. Today they are millions of times more
than the computer that guided Apollo 11 to the Moon. But using a phone late at night can make it harder to fall
, and we should control our phones instead of letting them control us.

words: a machine or tool made for a special job
did not believe something would work
very strong; able to do a lot
the bright screen keeps the brain alert
things you do often, almost without thinking
messages on a phone that tell you something new has happened

qs.q: Why can using a phone late at night make it harder to fall asleep?
qs.qko: 밤늦게 휴대폰을 쓰면 잠들기 어려운 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because the bright screen keeps the brain alert
Because phones are too heavy to hold in bed
Because notifications make the room cold
evs: Using a phone late at night can make it harder to fall asleep, because the bright screen keeps the brain alert.
It had no keyboard, only a touch screen.
Many people check their phones dozens of times a day, even during meals with their families.
We can video call friends on the other side of the world, pay for things, and find our way in a new city.
why: 밤늦게 휴대폰을 쓰면 밝은 화면 때문에 뇌가 깨어 있게 되어 잠들기 어려워진다고 했어요.
The bright screen keeps the brain alert, so it is harder to fall asleep.

qs.q: In "a phone, a music player, and an internet computer, all in one," what does "all in one" mean?
qs.qko: «a phone, a music player, and an internet computer, all in one» 에서 «all in one» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: It was a phone, a music player, and an internet computer, all in one.
Some experts doubted the idea, but the iPhone and other smartphones soon spread around the world.
Here is a surprising fact: a modern smartphone is millions of times more powerful than the computer that guided Apollo 11 to the Moon.
Experts suggest simple habits, like turning off notifications and keeping phones out of the bedroom at night.
why: 전화기, 음악 플레이어, 인터넷 컴퓨터가 작은 기기 «하나»에 다 들어 있다는 뜻이에요. «all in one» 은 여러 가지가 하나로 합쳐졌다는 말이에요.
A phone, a music player, and an internet computer were in one small device, so «all in one» means combined in a single thing.

qs.q: What new problems has the power of smartphones brought?
qs.qko: 스마트폰의 힘은 어떤 새로운 문제를 가져왔나요?
opts: People check phones even during family meals, and late-night phone use makes sleep harder
Phones can no longer make video calls
Smartphones are weaker than old computers
evs: Many people check their phones dozens of times a day, even during meals with their families.
We can video call friends on the other side of the world, pay for things, and find our way in a new city.
Using a phone late at night can make it harder to fall asleep, because the bright screen keeps the brain alert.
Here is a surprising fact: a modern smartphone is millions of times more powerful than the computer that guided Apollo 11 to the Moon.
why: 많은 사람이 가족과 밥을 먹는 중에도 휴대폰을 확인하고, 밤늦게 휴대폰을 쓰면 잠들기 어려워진다고 했어요. 두 가지 문제를 함께 봐야 해요.
Many people check their phones even during family meals, and using a phone late at night makes it harder to fall asleep. You need both sentences.

ends: How can families make healthy rules for using phones?
가족이 함께 지킬 건강한 휴대폰 규칙은 어떻게 만들 수 있을까요?
How did people talk to faraway friends before phones?
휴대폰이 없던 시절에는 멀리 있는 친구와 어떻게 이야기했을까요?

write.src: “We should <u>keep our phones out of the bedroom</u> so that <u>we can fall asleep easily</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «우리가 해야 할 일 + 그 결과» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and the result in English.

chips.a: put our phones away at meals
chips.b: we can talk with our family
chips.label: meals

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있다» 를 넣어 결과를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: so that we can talk more at dinner)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what they can do to make the result clear. (e.g. so that we can talk more at dinner)
